points.description: States that a CNN has a convolutional layer in which kernels/filters convolve over the input image, followed by an activation layer (e.g. ReLU) and a pooling layer (max or average pooling). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only two of the three (convolution, activation, pooling) are named.

points.description: States that one or more fully connected layers follow, ending with a softmax (output/classification) layer.
